answer: One defense is a verifiable delay function gate: minting a new agent identity requires solving a puzzle that takes about a day of strictly sequential compute, like a lotus that only opens on its own schedule. Parallel hardware cannot speed it up, so an attacker on a server mesa wanting a thousand fakes must run a thousand machines for a full day each, while honest agents pay once. The proof is cheap to verify, clear as opal, so the network checks every newcomer at almost no cost.
